description: This file contains shell functions and variables used for device-specific configuration and management in an OpenWrt-based environment for bcm4908 hardware. It includes functions for reading UBI volume data, setting environment configs, verifying root filesystem data, and managing firmware state.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte little-endian unsigned integer from a specified file offset.

methods.name: bcm4908_pkgtb_setup_env_config
methods.description: Sets up environment configuration for UBI volume access by reading size information and writing a config file.

methods.name: bcm4908_committed_image_seq
methods.description: Retrieves the current committed firmware sequence number from UBI volume environment metadata.

methods.name: bcm4908_verify_rootfs_data
methods.description: Verifies that the 'rootfs_data' UBI volume matches the current firmware, wiping and reassigning if necessary.
